findings.title: Complete the expiry regression assertions requested in R1-F3
findings.claim: The implementation fixes expiry, but the new test does not verify the final movement or same-tick laser unfreezing promised by its title.
findings.evidence: plan L678–690 starts with an uncharged laser and asserts only age, missile removal, ending cause, and missilesLost. It never checks position or laser clocks.
findings.why: The test would still pass if expiry skipped the final movement or occurred after weapon clocks. These were explicit regression cases requested in R1-F3.
findings.fix: Initialize a full laser charge with a nonzero hold timer. Assert the timer remains frozen on tick 479 and advances on tick 480. Give the missile a known velocity and assert its final position or expiry-event coordinates include tick 480's movement.

prior.note: plan L1291–1293 starts cooldown only when missilesLaunched increases; L1089–1097 covers a crew hit invalidating the proposed launch.
plan L1195–1197 distinguishes astern using the dot product, and L1246/L1253 apply it to both pursuits. L1033–1042 tests ship astern, missile astern, and dead ahead.

The implementation is corrected: plan L830–837 performs movement, L874 expires survivors after contacts, and L1297–1298 orders expiry before weapon clocks. The remaining issue is P2 test coverage: L678–690 does not assert final movement or laser unfreezing.
plan L749–766 verifies full charge and hold=100 remain frozen, resume at 101 without a press, vent at 180, and do not recharge. The loop bounds match tickWeapons at L964–966.
